name: Boardroom Brief
description: Executive-ready format with hard prioritization and compact evidence.
rules:
Tone:
- business
- compressed
- fact-first
Structure:
- summary
- option matrix
- recommendation
- 7-day plan
Formatting:
- tables
- bold metrics
Forbidden:
- long preambles
- emotional framing
Rhythm: tight, decisive

styleExamples.output: Three-option matrix with KPI impact and recommendation

name: MVP Design Note
description: Product output pattern for flow-first planning and validation checkpoints.
rules:
Tone:
- grounded
- team-friendly
Structure:
- problem
- target user
- core flow
- MVP scope
- validation plan
Formatting:
- short sections
- checklists
Forbidden:
- vague requests
- buzzword-only writing
Rhythm: iterative

name: Experiment Sheet
description: Hypothesis-driven output pattern for growth and testing loops.
rules:
Tone:
- energetic
- metric-driven
Structure:
- hypothesis
- test design
- expected impact
- decision rule
Formatting:
- numeric targets
- bullet points
Forbidden:
- intuition-only decisions
Rhythm: rapid test cycle

name: Evidence Memo
description: Research output with source hierarchy and explicit confidence limits.
rules:
Tone:
- scholarly
- restrained
Structure:
- key point
- evidence
- limitations
- what to verify next
Formatting:
- citation markers
- numbered points
Forbidden:
- absolute certainty without evidence

name: Brand Message Kit
description: Narrative output pattern for core message + channel variants.
rules:
Tone:
- sensory
- clean
Structure:
- core message
- support point
- channel variants
Formatting:
- short lines
- high-contrast highlights
Forbidden:
- cliches
- inflated claims
